articles.headline: Rio Ferdinand leads reaction to Man City's 115 breaches case: 'Another Premier League medal'
articles.description: The football world has been reacting to reports that Manchester City are expected to be found guilty of most charges in their legal battle with the Premier League.
articles.headlineJa: リオ・ファーディナンド、マンCの115件の違反問題に反応：「プレミアリーグのメダルがもう1枚もらえる」
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグとの法闘争において大半の容疑で有罪になると見込まれているとの報道に対し、サッカー界で大きな反応が広がっています。
articles.body:
The football world has been reacting to reports that a decision on Manchester City's longstanding legal battle with the Premier League over an alleged 115 breaches of financial regulations may be right around the corner. 

City are expected to be found guilty on the vast majority of charges of financial breaches in their legal case with the Premier League, a source has confirmed to ESPN.

In a statement, City didn't deny the verdicts and said that the process "remains ongoing."

When contacted by ESPN on Friday, the Premier League said they wouldn't comment on a "private and confidential process."

Friday's reports have given fresh impetus to speculation that City could be in line for a hefty punishment, with some hoping the major honours they won during the period covered by the investigation (2009-2018) could be redistributed to their beaten foes. 

- Man City vs. Premier League: 115 financial charges explained

David de Gea, who was part of the Manchester United team that finished as runners-up when City racked up 100 points in 2017-18, wrote in a post on X: "So... Let's talk. How many Premier League titles have I won then?"

His former United teammate Rio Ferdinand posted: "Another premier league medal to be added to the cabinet."

Rodri, who left City for Barcelona this summer, said he believes "everything was deserved." Rodri joined City from Atletico Madrid in 2019, one year after the end of the period in which the charges relate.

"When you live daily at that club, all the people that worked hard all these years to have the success we had, Pep, the owners, all the guys who worked on it, they can't take that from us. It's something that isn't paid for with money, it's effort, partnership, standing shoulder to shoulder," he told a news conference ahead of Spain's Nations League match against England.

"We had a lot of success, here at Wembley, and I can tell you that everything was deserved."

Erling Haaland was due to speak to the media on Saturday ahead of Norway's Nations League match against Portugal on Sunday but head coach Stale Solbakken confirmed that, given the news surrounding City and what happened at Rodri's Spain news conference, it would be better for Haaland to avoid fielding questions on the issue. Fredrik Aursnes and Andreas Schjelderup attended instead.

Oasis frontman and City superfan Noel Gallagher, reacted to the news on the Let Me Talk podcast, saying he was "a little surprised when I heard it on the radio. Surprised because only that the club have assured us all along that they vehemently denied any of these charges.

"So it was a bit of a shock to find out that we've been found guilty of all but one. But really overall just quite sad really. Sad for the fans and for the players."

Asked if it changes the context of moments like Sergio Agüero's title-winning goal in 2012, Gallagher added: "Our focus as fans is always on the pitch and we know what we saw -- they won it on the pitch.

articles.headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
articles.description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season
articles.headlineJa: 代表ウィークで負傷したプレミアリーグの選手は誰？
articles.descriptionJa: 2026-2027シーズンの最初の代表ウィーク中に負傷したプレミアリーグのスター選手に関する最新ニュースと更新情報をお届けします。
articles.body:
Premier League teams will be watching and hoping their star players remain healthy throughout the international break.

However, some have already sustained injuries while playing for their countries. Premier League matches resume on Oct. 10.

ESPN will be tracking the latest injuries and updates for your club's players:

Kai Havertz (Arsenal)

Arsenal's Kai Havertz was forced off in the 30th minute of the game between Netherlands and Germany on September 24th with what was described as a muscle injury.

"Both are currently undergoing an MRI," Jurgen Klopp said on RTL about Havertz and Jamal Musiala. "I hope we get the diagnosis [on Thursday] evening. But of course, this isn't great. I hope it's nothing serious. The lads are probably out for us. But hopefully, they'll be back in action relatively quickly."

On September 25 the German Football Association confirmed the attacker would be leaving Klopp's camp and return to Arsenal after suffering what they describe as a 'muscle strain.'

Brian Brobbey (Sunderland)

The powerful Sunderland attacker was also injured in the same game after picking up what looked like a hamstring injury while running for the ball. He immediately went down and signalled to the sideline.

He left the field of his own accord but did have a heavy limp as he walked down the tunnel.

Netherlands boss Xavi Hernandez said after the game: "Brian is indeed injured."

Brobbey was replaced by Joshua Zirkzee in the Dutch squad.

Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa)

The goalkeeper linked up with the Japan squad but according to reports missed the main group training session on September 22nd, according to local reports. Instead he was put on an individual session for a rib injury.

Suzuki was subsequently left out of Japan's matchday squad entirely for Thursday's 3-1 victory over Uruguay.

Dan Ballard (Sunderland)

The Sunderland defender suffered a reported hamstring injury during Northern Ireland's 1-0 victory over Georgia in the UEFA Nations League.

With the score still 0-0 as the match moved into stoppage time, Ballard chased back as Georgia counter-attacked and pulled up clutching the back of his thigh, unable to finish the match in Tbilisi.

Speaking immediately after Friday's match, manager Michael O'Neill said it was too soon to know the extent of his latest injury but will definitely miss the next three Northern Ireland games.

"We'll scan him tomorrow (Saturday), but he's certainly not going to be available for the next three games."

International breaks this season

1. Sept. 21-Oct. 6 (between Premier League gameweeks 5 and 6)

2. Nov. 9-Nov. 17 (between Premier League gameweeks 10 and 11)

3. March 22-March 30 (between Premier League gameweeks 30 and 31)

articles.headline: Host Jalen Brunson gets assist from Knicks on 'SNL' premiere
articles.description: Jalen Brunson had four of his Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of "SNL."
articles.headlineJa: 『SNL』初回放送でホストを務めたジェイレン・ブランソン、ニックスのチームメイトからアシストを受ける
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜夜の『SNL』でホストを務めたジェイレン・ブランソンは、冒頭モノローグの際、観客席にニックスのチームメイト4人（カール＝アンソニー・タウンズ、ミカル・ブリッジズ、OG・アヌノビー、ジョシュ・ハート）を迎えた。
articles.body:
Jalen Brunson brought four of his NBA champion teammates to "Saturday Night Live."

The reigning NBA Finals MVP had four of his New York Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of the NBC program's 52nd season premiere.

Brunson poked fun at how he's not going to sing, how ESPN's Stephen A. Smith -- a Knicks fan, portrayed during the monologue by longtime "SNL" star Kenan Thompson -- owed him an apology for questioning his abilities and even quipped about how much he's looking forward to getting back to the Knicks' home court at Madison Square Garden.

"The exact spot where Taylor and Travis got married," Brunson said, referring to the summer wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce at the team's arena.

But the best assists came from Towns, Bridges, Anunoby and Hart, who all asked Brunson questions as part of the monologue.

Towns asked if someone could foul out of "SNL." When told it's not possible, Towns said, "So I can be here, like, the whole show? Nice."

Bridges asked Brunson if his arms were long, but lamented that he'll never fly. Anunoby, who got a huge ovation, asked Brunson if he recalled missing a shot late in Game 4 of the NBA Finals against San Antonio -- a series that the Knicks won in five games. The Game 4 shot that Anunoby was referring to was a last-second tip-in -- off a Brunson miss -- that basically ensured the Knicks would win the game.

"That was awesome," Anunoby said.

Hart, who co-hosts a podcast with Brunson, asked his New York teammate about how he left $113 million on the bargaining table when signing with the Knicks. Brunson, in turn, asked why Hart poked Brunson in the backside when the Knicks won the NBA Cup last season.

Brunson then brought his teammates to the stage for one last roar from the crowd.

Brunson became the first active NBA player to host the show since LeBron James -- then of the Cleveland Cavaliers -- in 2007, and the first pro athlete in the role since Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs' tight end, in 2023.

The other NBA players to host besides Brunson and James: Michael Jordan in 1991, Charles Barkley on four occasions (including one as an active player in 1993) and Bill Russell in 1979. Russell's stint came 10 years after he retired as a player.

Brunson, Jordan, Barkley and James all hosted season premieres of "SNL." And Brunson promised to step up late, just like what he delivered in crunch time of the Knicks' games in the title series against the Spurs in June.

"I'm going to approach this the same way I approach a Knicks Finals game," Brunson said. "The first three quarters of the show are going to be god-awful. The last sketch is going to be amazing."

articles.headline: England boss Thomas Tuchel: Potential Man City punishments not a distraction in Spain defeat
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has insisted Manchester City's potential punishment for breaching Premier League financial rules was not a distraction for his England players in Saturday's 3-2 Nations League defeat to Spain.
articles.headlineJa: イングランド代表トーマス・トゥヘル監督：マンCへの処分の可能性はスペイン戦敗北で集中を欠いた理由ではない
articles.descriptionJa: トーマス・トゥヘル監督は、プレミアリーグの財務ルール違反によるマンチェスター・シティへの処分可能性について、土曜日のネーションズリーグでスペインに2-3で敗れた試合において、イングランド代表の選手たちの集中を削ぐものではなかったと主張した。
articles.body:
LONDON -- Thomas Tuchel has insisted Manchester City's potential punishment for breaching Premier League financial rules was not a distraction for his England players in Saturday's 3-2 Nations League defeat to Spain.

A source told ESPN on Friday that City are expected to be found guilty in the vast majority of the 115 charges relating to alleged misconduct between 2009 and 2018.

City trio Marc Guéhi, Nico O'Reilly and Elliot Anderson all started at Wembley barely 24 hours after news of the likely guilty verdict broke.

City continue to deny all charges and the Premier League declined to comment when contacted by ESPN.

England captain Harry Kane said there had been a "discussion" within the group about City's situation while both Guéhi and O'Reilly made individual mistakes, as Spain came from 2-1 down to win through substitute Mikel Oyarzabal's 74th-minute strike.

Asked whether the City situation could be an issue during the international break, Tuchel said: "Not for me but I can imagine maybe for the Manchester City players but for me not and I will not comment on that because it is an ongoing court case so I will not give any comment.

"I didn't make it a topic. It was not a topic for me. I hear the news as the latest person in camp. I was just thinking about Spain and training and meetings and media meetings and individual meetings. Not for me. For the players, they have more time than me, they have one training session. I can imagine they talk about it. It is good they do. I didn't feel they were distracted."

Speaking to ITV, Kane said: "There was a discussion, but at the end of the day when we're with England, that's been a big plus for us, we kind of put club football to one side and it was no different this week."

- Hamilton, Olley: Spain expose England's shortcomings in breathtaking Wembley comeback

- Ogden: Man City verdict will leave a stain and stench on a Premier League era

England fell behind after just two minutes as Guehi gifted Lamine Yamal the chance to open the scoring. Anthony Gordon equalised before Kane's deflected header put the Three Lions 2-1 in front at the break.

Kane missed a penalty to put England 3-1 up on 54 minutes before world champions Spain responded as Álex Baena and Oyarzabal both came off the bench to score in a thrilling League A Group 3 opener.

"I think in this moment it [Kane's penalty] would have been the decisive punch to get this full momentum and full belief into our match with a two-goal advantage," Tuchel said.

"Couldn't do it, made unfortunately another technical mistake that cost us, and then the momentum shifted again. We conceded one goal from open play that we should absolutely defend better because they play through the middle.

"The result is not what we wanted. I think we could have won it, so we have to live with it, recover from it, learn from it, do what we did good on the same level, and reduce and improve our own mistakes."

articles.headline: Broncos place RB Jonah Coleman (ankle) on IR
articles.description: Denver Broncos rookie running back Jonah Coleman was placed on injured reserve Saturday with an ankle injury he suffered in the team's Week 2 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
articles.headlineJa: ブロンコス、RBジョナ・コールマンを足首の負傷でIR登録
articles.descriptionJa: デンバー・ブロンコスの新人ランニングバック、ジョナ・コールマンが、チームがジャクソンビル・ジャガーズに勝利した第2週の試合で足首を負傷し、土曜日に故障者リスト（IR）に登録された。
articles.body:
Denver Broncos rookie running back Jonah Coleman was placed on injured reserve Saturday with an ankle injury he suffered in the team's Week 2 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.

Coleman already had been ruled out of Sunday night's game against the Los Angeles Rams. The IR move means he will miss at least three additional games.

A source told ESPN's Adam Schefter that the injury is a high ankle sprain and Coleman is expected to return when first eligible, Oct. 25 against the Arizona Cardinals.

For now, it leaves the Broncos without the player who had been the back of choice in their game-clinching drive against the Jaguars. The fourth-round pick had 33 of his 39 rushing yards on the final possession when the Broncos ran out the final 4:41 of clock. 

J.K. Dobbins, who left last weekend's game in the third quarter with a hamstring injury, practiced fully Thursday and Friday and will be the primary back against the Rams. RJ Harvey, who missed the Jaguars game with a hamstring injury, also practiced fully to close out the week and will be available.

Broncos coach Sean Payton would not expand on the seriousness of Coleman's injury Friday but did say Dobbins and Harvey "had a good week'' and that the team would "be OK'' at running back. Tyler Badie had been the only running back on the active roster who had been a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

Coleman had his first career touchdown on a 3-yard run against the Jaguars. He had received treatment on the injured ankle throughout the week and had been in uniform and on the practice field throughout the week but did not take part in any team drills.

The Broncos also signed long-snapper Mitchell Fraboni from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday and elevated fullback Adam Prentice and wide receiver Kolbe Katsis from the practice squad to the roster for Sunday's game.

Wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr, an All-Pro returner in 2024, is questionable for Sunday's game with a foot injury, and Katsis was one of the team's more productive returners in training camp.

articles.description: Updated inactives and analysis based on the latest reports and official announcements leading up to kickoff.

articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 3 Buzz 

Week 3 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 3

Biggest concerns heading into Week 3

Players with early starts

DJ Moore, WR, Bills (shoulder): Moore was limited Wednesday and wearing a noncontact jersey. He then missed practice Thursday before logging another limited session with the noncontact jersey Friday. He is questionable heading into Week 3 -- and truly could go in either direction, although it's worth noting that Moore has not missed a game since 2020. If he's active, fantasy managers should plan to start him, even if he is somewhat limited. If he sits, expect Khalil Shakir to see more work. 

Keon Coleman, WR, Bills (ankle): Coleman also missed practice this week. He was able to log a limited session Friday and is also questionable heading into Sunday. If Coleman sits, Joshua Palmer and Skyler Bell will be the next options. The main target for Buffalo would be Dalton Kincaid. Some potential outside replacement options for any missing Bills are Devaughn Vele, Denzel Boston, Josh Downs, Adonai Mitchell*, and Dontayvion Wicks.

*See below.

Jalen Coker, WR, Panthers (ankle): After missing practice Thursday, Coker returned in a limited fashion Friday -- his second practice of the week. He is questionable for Week 3. It's worth noting that Coker missed practice last week and still ended up suiting up (and performing adequately for fantasy managers). He has seen nine targets in both games this season. In fact, his usage is very similar to Tetairoa McMillan, only Coker is seeing a higher number of efficient targets. If Coker suits up against the Browns, he is in play. If he sits, some replacement options would be the same as those listed above for Coleman.

 Malik Nabers, WR, Giants (shoulder): Nabers suffered his injury during "Monday Night Football" but was able to return to the field. He did pop up on the practice report this week but was able to log in full practices and is good to go for Week 3. Though he is a more volatile fantasy option with Jameis Winston under center, he still brings enough upside to be viewed as a WR2.

Adonai Mitchell, WR, Jets (finger): The Jets receiver was added to the practice report Thursday and logged two limited practices. He is questionable for Week 3. articles.headline: Sources: Bulls to trade Dillingham to Hornets for Buddy Hield
articles.description: The Chicago Bulls are trading Rob Dillingham to the Charlotte Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者情報：ブルズがバディ・ヒールドとのトレードでディリンガムをホーネッツへ放出へ
articles.descriptionJa: シカゴ・ブルズがロブ・ディリンガムをシャーロット・ホーネッツへ放出し、バディ・ヒールドと金銭を獲得するトレードを行うと、関係者が土曜日にESPNのシャムズ・シャラニア記者に明かした。
articles.body:
The Chicago Bulls are trading Rob Dillingham to the Charlotte Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Saturday.

Dillingham, the No. 8 pick in the 2024 NBA draft and still just 21 years old, is being traded less than a year after landing in Chicago at the trade deadline last season. He appeared in 30 games for the Bulls, averaging 9.6 points and 2.8 assists.

Dillingham could have a chance for a larger role in Charlotte, which traded longtime starting guard LaMelo Ball to the Timberwolves earlier this offseason. News of this trade comes just one day after the Hornets announced that second-year guard Kon Knueppel has been sidelined with a hamstring injury.

The Hornets create a $9.6 million trade exception with the deal. 

Hield spent less than a week with the Hornets, who acquired the veteran sharpshooter from the Atlanta Hawks for Dorian Finney-Smith. Hield, known as a positive and high-energy player, has history with Bulls executive vice president Bryson Graham from their time together in New Orleans. 

Dillingham has one more year via a team option on his rookie contract before hitting restricted free agency in the summer of 2028. Hield has a player option worth around $10 million for the 2027-28 season.

articles.headline: Patriots need rookie LB Gabe Jacas to fill big shoes on defense
articles.description: The second-round pick has made impact plays over the first two weeks and will start vs. the Jaguars. Here's the latest on Jacas and other notes on the Patriots.
articles.headlineJa: ペイトリオッツ、守備陣で大きな穴を埋めるルーキーLBゲイブ・ジャカスに期待
articles.descriptionJa: ドラフト2巡目指名のルーキーは開幕からの2週間でインパクトのあるプレーを見せており、ジャガーズ戦で先発出場する。ジャカスの最新情報とペイトリオッツのその他のニュース。
articles.body:
FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- Quick-hit thoughts and notes around the New England Patriots and NFL:

1. Jacas' motor: The short-handed Patriots defense is likely to turn to rookie outside linebacker Gabe Jacas as a starter in Sunday's road game against the Jacksonville Jaguars (1 p.m. ET, CBS), which might have been a concern a couple of weeks ago. But the second-round pick from Illinois has been one of the team's early-season surprises, which had Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers praising his relentlessness as the conversation surrounding Jacas has shifted as quickly as he darts to the football.

Jacas, 22, has a motor-always-runs-hot play style. It has contributed to the Patriots (1-1) allowing just 16 points, helped him break the NFL's longest QB streak without an interception by recording the first pick against Rodgers since Week 10 of last season, and will be a key against Trevor Lawrence & Co. in Jacksonville with starting outside linebacker Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) ailing.

"That really came from when I started wrestling -- having that relentless mindset to not be denied," said Jacas, who was a two-time state championship grappler in high school.

"And also having my brother [Khaliq] as a coach. He coached me that at an early age -- always run to the football, always having that motor. You never know what can happen if you run to the ball. Ever since then, running to the ball has been something that I do adamantly -- just like last game, stuff like that happens."

Coach Mike Vrabel highlighted Jacas' hustle interception as an example of his improvement and willingness to take coaching.

When defending a prior similar slip screen, Jacas ran to the quarterback and jumped in the air. Vrabel and outside linebackers coach Mike Smith told him the more effective approach is to put his foot in the ground, retrace and run to the football -- which is what he did against Rodgers.

In addition, Vrabel spotlighted Jacas' strong play to tie up Steelers left tackle Troy Fautanu (2024 first-round pick), which freed up looping linebacker Christian Elliss for a crunching sack of Rodgers that was heard across the NFL.

That Jacas would be involved in so many impact plays felt like a longshot a few weeks ago. He missed the entire spring after undergoing a knee procedure, which contributed to a contract impasse that led to him not signing his deal until a couple days into training camp.

Then he was playing catch-up, which showed throughout the preseason when his aggressiveness had him out of position multiple times. But he had 19 snaps in the season-opening loss at Seattle (three tackles, sack), then saw a major uptick in playing time last week against the Steelers (49 snaps, 2 tackles, INT).

articles.headline: Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question
articles.description: The Jets promoted veteran Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, as starting WR Adonai Mitchell is questionable with a finger injury, and three other Jets receivers are on injured reserve.
articles.headlineJa: アドナイ・ミッチェルの出場が不透明な中、ジェッツがスターリング・シェパードを昇格
articles.descriptionJa: 先発WRアドナイ・ミッチェルが指の負傷で出場不透明となり、他に3人のレシーバーが負傷者リストに入っているため、ジェッツはプラクティス・スコードからベテランのスターリング・シェパードを昇格させました。
articles.body:
DETROIT -- With starting wide receiver Adonai Mitchell listed as questionable with a finger injury, the New York Jets added two receivers Saturday to the active roster for Sunday against the Detroit Lions.

Veteran Sterling Shepard was elevated from the practice squad and is expected to make his Jets debut. First-year player Jamaal Pritchett, signed from the practice squad, is available to make his NFL debut.

The Jets already have three receivers on injured reserve, including first-round pick Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle). Mitchell, the most targeted player on the team (15), showed up on the injury report Thursday after his finger got caught in a teammate's jersey at practice.

Mitchell practiced Friday with a heavy wrap on his right hand. His index and middle fingers appeared to be splinted. Coach Aaron Glenn wouldn't disclose the nature of the injury, except to say, "I don't think it's broke."

Mitchell has emerged as a key member of the passing attack. He's their top vertical threat, with nine receptions for 123 yards -- second to Garrett Wilson in both categories.

If Mitchell can't play or is limited against the Lions (1-1), Isaiah Williams and Shepard likely would be the second and third receivers.

Sterling, 33, arrived only two weeks ago on the practice squad. The 10-year veteran caught 39 passes for 371 yards and one touchdown last season for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Their other is undrafted rookie Malik McClain, who has no game experience. Pritchett returns kicks and could replace Kene Nwangwu (back), who was ruled out on Saturday.

The Jets also will be without tight end Mason Taylor (thumb).

articles.headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
articles.description: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.
articles.headlineJa: ベアーズQBウィリアムズがMNF欠場へ、控えのベイジェントは練習再開
articles.descriptionJa: ベアーズのQBケイレブ・ウィリアムズは月曜日のイーグルス戦を欠場することになり、控えのタイソン・ベイジェントは脳震盪プロトコルにとどまりつつも練習グラウンドに戻ってきました。
articles.body:
Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Monday night's game against the Philadelphia Eagles.

Williams injured his right hamstring late in Chicago's 9-3 loss to the Vikings in Week 2. He did not practice ahead of the Eagles game and is considered week-to-week.

Williams has not missed a start since being drafted by the Bears with the first overall pick in 2024.

Meanwhile, Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent was back on the practice field Saturday in full capacity. While he remains in the NFL's concussion protocol, Bagent was able to participate in the Bears' final practice and is listed as questionable on the team's injury report.

 

Bagent was not back at Halas Hall until Friday as he progressed through the early phases of the NFL's five-phase protocol. He participated in meetings on Friday and was able to practice Saturday.

"I mean we've got a sense that we want to get him healthy first and foremost," coach Ben Johnson said. "That was his No. 1 priority. And then since it's progressed along, he was able to be in meetings yesterday and now he's in practice today, and so he's right on track to be right where he needs to be. And I think mentally he's going to be in a good spot for what we're asking to do."

Johnson said the Bears are still determining their quarterback depth chart against the Eagles, including who will start. Case Keenum, the Bears' third-string quarterback, has participated all three days in practice and could start his first regular-season game since Dec. 2024.

"There's a different skill set, obviously," Johnson said. "One guy's a little bit more mobile than the other, and yet both are very cerebral players. I know they'll be mentally prepared for the game, and we'll see what it looks like. But there's a reason why Tyson was the backup as we ended camp, and we felt good about who he is as a player and what he can bring to the table to this offense.

"And so, [I] would be excited to get him out there as well. So I think we've got a lot of good choices. We'll come together as a staff and make sure we're on the same page."

Additionally, the Bears' kicking battery is at full strength ahead of Monday night. Kicker Cairo Santos, who was a nonparticipant Thursday and Friday with a right hip injury, practiced in full Saturday. He does not carry an injury designation.

"We felt good about where he was at," Johnson said. "Everybody's a little bit different. We always try to make sure we're prepared and have contingency plans if things go a little bit sideways, but that's a spot that we felt pretty good about."

After being removed from the injury report for the first time since being activated from the PUP list in mid-August, left tackle Ozzy Trapilo was a full participant in every practice this week but won't make his return against the Eagles.
